name: demo-domain-audit
description: Three AI security agents (H1 Reconnaissance, S11 TLS, S18 Email & Domain) and a Chief that coordinates them to audit a domain you own. A teaching demo based on Cyber360.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run your first AI security agents
interface.longDescription: A teaching demo extracted from Cyber360. The Chief confirms your authority, then runs H1 Reconnaissance, S11 TLS & Cryptography Security and S18 Email & Domain Security against a domain you own and writes an evidence-backed HTML and JSON report for each agent.
defaultPrompt: Use $demo-domain-audit:setup-tools to install and verify the required tools.
